Codex Whip 1.8.1
A quiet heads-up when a new version is ready.
• A new update is available… appears at the top of the menu with an orange dot. • Click the notice to review the update and choose when to install. • With Automatic Updates off, quiet daily checks stay on while new updates wait for your choice. • Existing preferences migrate once without enabling automatic downloads.
Your retry settings, session state, history, app identity and update-verification key are preserved.
macOS 14 or later. This community build is ad hoc signed and is not Apple-notarized.
